home.heroTitle: Divvy – Smart Ledger For Every Friend Group & Family
home.heroSub: Manage shared expenses transparently, automatically, and conveniently. Automatically balance debts between members, eliminate confusion and settle money disputes after every trip, dining, or group activity.
home.welcomeUser: Welcome {{username}}! You are ready to manage groups.
home.archSub: Structured data makes it easy to track from the smallest expense to group balances.
home.feature1Desc: Create groups by category (Travel, Apartment, Sports...). Set default currency (VND, USD...), notes, and duration.
home.feature2Desc: Invite friends via email link or token. Flexible Admin / Member role permissions.
home.feature3Desc: Record 1 or multiple payers paying in advance. Select exact list of members participating in the split.
home.feature4Desc: Algorithm automatically offsets paid amounts vs shares to produce "Who owes Whom how much".
home.feature5Desc: Record settlements via cash or bank transfer. Instantly update debt balances upon completion.
home.feature6Desc: Audit log records all actions: create group, add expense, edit amount, settle debt... 100% transparency.
home.step1Desc: Enter description ("Hotpot dinner"), total amount ($100), category, and currency.
home.step2Desc: Record who paid in advance (e.g. A paid $80, B paid $20).
home.step3Desc: Select members participating in the bill (4 people A, B, C, D -> $25/person).
home.step4Desc: Divvy calculates A as creditor, C and D owe A (PENDING).
home.step5Desc: C and D transfer money to A, click "Settle Up" to complete debt.
home.ctaTitle: Ready To Manage Group Funds Transparently With Divvy?
home.ctaSub: No more manual notes or calculations. Experience Divvy today!
